answer.justification: Median first divergence is 7 and edit distance 0.591, both in the fine-tuned range. Top-1 agreement 0.910 and KL 0.095 are also fine-tuned, not the quantized range (KL 0.039-0.071). Layer-1 L2 of 0.085 is just below the quantized minimum of 0.096. Layer 32 L2 of 0.411 with a final-layer jump of +0.108 fits fine-tuned, as does a final cosine of 0.908. Direction consistency of 0.700 and effective rank of 3.05 are fine-tuned; quantized would be about 0.51 and 4. The mid-layer size ratio of 1.022 means the state grew, which matches fine-tuned (quantized shrinks it). The layer-2 spike of 1.9 is small, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64). Raw-score shift÷TV of 9.2 is also in the fine-tuned range. Three refusals dropped is possible for fine-tuned. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
